purpose: Verify that adapters translate an already-resolved professional shot without choosing the provider, redesigning the image, or turning competitor systems into default backends.

scoring.pass_condition: Provider selection must occur before adaptation. Normal adapters may change serialization/verified controls only. Magnific/Higgsfield adapters may be used only for explicit user targets or controlled benchmarks.
critical_failures: external provider selected before an adequate native/local path without explicit provider lock or missing material capability
Magnific/Higgsfield selected automatically for ordinary generation
adapter changes creative shot or Professional Quality Floor
hard lock or preservation boundary silently changed
provider defaults add unjustified strong cinematic effects
adapter existence treated as provider access
successful execution reported as V2 without visual inspection
